environment: macOS (Darwin 25.6.0), Python 3.14.7, Node 24.19.0, git 2.50.1; testkit cli-runner with a scratch HOME and a controlled env, attack-corpus, scratch git repos; no network and no services

cases.title: A missing, empty or wrong part exits 2 with one JSON error that names the part
cases.given: A scratch git repo with no config
cases.when: name runs 11 times: run with no --n; milestone and e2e with no --id or with --id ''; e2e-area with no --area, --area '' or no --id; run with --id 1; milestone with --n 1; e2e with --n and --area only
cases.then: Each call exits 2 and prints one JSON object with ok false and an error that ends in 'non-empty <part>'. Stderr is empty. No Traceback. No file or ref changes.
cases.expected: exit 2; the error names n, id or area; no side effect
cases.actual: All 11 calls exit 2 with errors such as 'a run branch name needs a non-empty n'. Stderr is empty. The cwd and the repo are unchanged.
cases.specSource: Spec §2 tail: "A missing part is a Fail." Spec CLI contract: "Every command prints one JSON object; exit 2 with {"ok": false, "error": "..."} on bad input."

evidence.title: missing part, run
evidence.inline:
$ branches.py name --repo <repo> --kind run
exit: 2
--- stdout
{"ok": false, "error": "a run branch name needs a non-empty n"}
--- stderr

--- tree cwd (unchanged)
--- tree repo (unchanged)

cases.title: tail raises only Fail for a missing part and keeps 0 as a value
cases.given: branches.py loaded by path with python3 -I
cases.when: tail is called 14 times with a missing, None, empty or wrong-key part, and once with run n=0
cases.then: Every missing-part call raises Fail, never KeyError or TypeError. tail('run', n=0) returns 'run-0'.
cases.expected: 14 Fail outcomes and one return of run-0
cases.specSource: Spec §2 tail: "A missing part is a Fail."

cases.title: Every --n form gives run-<int> or one JSON error, and git accepts every non-negative accepted value
cases.given: A scratch git repo; 45 values: the integer-forms, huge-integers and unicode-digits families and the plan values 0, 1, 12, -1, 1.5, abc, ' 1', +1, 0x1, 1_000
cases.when: name --kind run --n=<value> runs once per value
cases.then: Exit 0 with branch sdlc/run-<str(int(value))> that git check-ref-format accepts, or exit 2 with one JSON error that names --n. No Traceback, empty stderr, no tree change.
cases.expected: No crash; the branch equals the Python print form of the int; a refusal names --n
cases.actual: 28 values are accepted, for example ' 3 ' gives sdlc/run-3, Arabic-Indic 3 gives sdlc/run-3 and 4300 nines give sdlc/run-999... . 17 values are refused with 'argument --n: invalid int value' (0x10, 1.5, inf, 4301 digits, 100k digits). -1 gives sdlc/run--1, the known gap of ADR-20261009-045048.
cases.specSource: R-003 acceptance; Spec CLI contract: "Every command prints one JSON object; exit 2 with {"ok": false, "error": "..."} on bad input." ADR-20261009-045048

evidence.title: refused and accepted forms
evidence.inline:
--n=0x10          -> exit 2 {"ok": false, "error": "argument --n: invalid int value: '0x10'"}
--n=1.5           -> exit 2 invalid int value
--n=<4301 nines>  -> exit 2 invalid int value
--n=' 3 '         -> exit 0 sdlc/run-3
--n=1_000         -> exit 0 sdlc/run-1000
--n=<Arabic-Indic 3> -> exit 0 sdlc/run-3
--n=-1            -> exit 0 sdlc/run--1 (ADR-20261009-045048 gap)

cases.title: tail run takes True, '7', 7 and 0 and returns a string
cases.given: branches.py loaded by path with python3 -I
cases.when: tail('run', n=True), n='7', n=7 and n=0
cases.then: Each call returns a string tail or raises Fail. No other exception.
cases.actual: run-True, run-7, run-7 and run-0, all strings.
cases.specSource: Spec §2 tail: "A missing part is a Fail." Plan VS-4 notes.

cases.title: Hostile --id and --area values never run a shell, write a file, import a planted module or expand a format
cases.given: A repo with planted json.py and subprocess.py; a cwd with decoy modules json, re, argparse, subprocess and os; 95 argv-safe values from traversal, control-chars, flag-like-values, injection, format-strings, unicode-whitespace, unicode-confusables and oversized
cases.when: name runs 380 times: milestone --id=V, e2e --id=V, e2e-area --area=V and e2e-area --id=V
cases.then: Exit 0 with the literal tail, or exit 2 for the empty value. One JSON line on stdout, empty stderr, no tree or ref change, no 'pwned' file, no decoy import.
cases.expected: No shell, no write, no import, a literal tail
cases.actual: 376 calls exit 0 with the exact literal tail. 4 calls exit 2 (the empty value; the error names id or area). 0 contract violations. No 'pwned' file. No decoy marker. '$(touch pwned)' stays literal in the branch.
cases.specSource: Spec CLI contract: "Every command prints one JSON object; exit 2 with {"ok": false, "error": "..."} on bad input." Plan VS-5 notes; ADR-20261009-045048

--- stderr

--- tree cwd (unchanged)
--- tree repo (unchanged)
pwned files: none; decoy markers: none

seeds.title: branches.py name prints branch names that git refuses for a hostile milestone id or e2e area
seeds.detail: name --kind milestone, e2e and e2e-area accept an id or area with '..', a space, a control character, braces or a leading slash. The printed branch fails git check-ref-format --branch in 144 of 380 combinations, for example sdlc/../.. and sdlc/$(touch pwned). ADR-20261009-045048 accepts this gap, because the format check probes only the sample S-001. A git check-ref-format check of the final branch, or an id shape check, closes it. List: .sdlc/slices/S-004/verification/r0/logs/security-0-vs5-git-refused.txt.

seeds.title: tail('run', n=<int over 4300 digits>) raises ValueError, not Fail
seeds.detail: tail builds f'run-{n}', and Python refuses to print an int over 4300 digits. So tail raises ValueError. The CLI cannot reach this, because argparse int refuses the same digit count. The spec Fail contract names only a missing part. Probe: .sdlc/slices/S-004/verification/r0/logs/security-0-seed-huge-n-api.txt.

seeds.title: --n accepts padded, signed, underscored and non-ASCII digit forms
seeds.detail: argparse int accepts ' 3 ', '+1', '-0', '1_000', '010' and Arabic-Indic or fullwidth digits. name prints the normalized ASCII number. The branch is valid, but the CLI does not report a typo. A strict ASCII digit check on --n refuses these forms.

seeds.title: The tail error text says 'a e2e branch name'
seeds.detail: The Fail message puts the article 'a' before e2e and e2e-area: 'a e2e branch name needs a non-empty id'. The message is clear but not grammatical.
